interpretations: Include orders with `order.amount` greater than 2802; inner join to `account` and `district`; average amounts by `order.account_id` and `district.A3`; take the unweighted average of those group averages; return the 10 groups with the largest positive difference from that overall average, without rounding.

Include orders with `order.amount` greater than or equal to 2802; inner join to `account` and `district`; average amounts by `order.account_id` and `district.A3`; take the unweighted average of those group averages; return the 10 groups with the largest positive difference from that overall average, without rounding.
queries:
WITH group_averages AS (
    SELECT o.account_id, d.A3, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM "order" AS o
    INNER JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    INNER JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE o.amount > 2802
    GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM group_averages
)
SELECT g.account_id, g.A3, g.avg_amount - oa.avg_amount AS difference
FROM group_averages AS g
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE g.avg_amount > oa.avg_amount
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH group_averages AS (
    SELECT o.account_id, d.A3, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM "order" AS o
    INNER JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    INNER JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE o.amount >= 2802
    GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM group_averages
)
SELECT g.account_id, g.A3, g.avg_amount - a.avg_amount AS difference
FROM group_averages AS g
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS a
WHERE g.avg_amount > a.avg_amount
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
